_about: GoldSrc (CS 1.6) player movement, ported into Minecraft. Every number the movement code uses is here. unit decides how a value is read: u = GoldSrc units (x unit_scale = blocks), u/s and u/s^2 likewise, blocks / s / ms / ratio / flag / text are used as written. 1 unit = 0.025 blocks, so the 72-unit CS player is 1.8 blocks. The pmove core runs at a fixed substep (substep_ms) several times per Minecraft tick, so strafing keeps its 100 Hz feel. Rows marked VERIFY in 'use' are values that were not checked against a CS 1.6 install.
